free_tier_limits.correction: 60 requests per API key per minute; PDF/ZIP and multi-case PDF/ZIP downloads are limited to 4 per key per minute. From 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. ET, the respective limits are 120 and 12.

rate_limits.correction: 60 requests per API key per minute; PDF/ZIP and multi-case PDF/ZIP downloads are limited to 4 per key per minute. Published limits are higher during off-peak hours.

notes: USPTO still publishes tsdrapi.uspto.gov endpoints and reports TSDR operational, so HTTP 0 is not sufficient evidence that the host is dead. The legacy Developer Hub catalog now redirects to the new Open Data Portal. Current official material confirms the API-key header and XML paths, but I could not authoritatively verify the example's exact JSON path.
